FN-SLYFF57-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 295
Committee: Transportation and Energy Sponsor: Senator Gerald H. Allen
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/10/2025
Senate Bill 295 as introduced could increase receipts to the Underground Damage Prevention
Fund by an undetermined amount dependent on any grants, assessments, and civil penalties
collected by the Underground Damage Prevention Authority that otherwise would not be
deposited into the fund, absent this bill.
